author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: MYIR has introduced the MYC-YM62LX system-on-module based on Texas Instruments’ AM62Lx processor family, along with the MYD-YM62LX development board. The platform is intended for embedded and industrial systems such as HMI devices, PLC controllers, EV charging equipment, medical systems, and industrial automation. title: MYIR Launches AM62Lx-based MYC-YM62LX SoM with 3× CAN-FD and 8× UART
